user.title: Choose a strip
user.description: Strips Home Assistant has heard over Bluetooth, through a local adapter or an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description:
Enter the 8-digit setup code printed on the strip or its box (the code by the QR code, e.g. 123-45-678). Pairing does not disturb the Nanoleaf app.

Firmware {firmware}. Firmware 5.0.0 and later is supported experimentally: on/off, brightness and colour only.

advanced.name: Advanced: use an existing auth token
advanced.description: For a strip already paired with another tool. Leave the setup code empty.

data_description.token: Hexadecimal, as printed by scripts/nanoleaf_cli.py pair.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair {name} again
reauth_confirm.description: The strip no longer accepts the stored auth token; it was probably factory-reset. Enter its setup code to pair again.

advanced.name: Advanced: use an existing auth token

reconfigure.title: Change the credentials of {name}
reconfigure.description: Pair again with the setup code, or switch to another auth token.

advanced.name: Advanced: use an existing auth token

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the strip. Check it is powered and in range of an adapter or proxy with a free connection slot, then try again.
error.invalid_auth: The strip refused the setup code.
error.invalid_token: The strip refused the auth token.
error.code_required: Enter the setup code, or an auth token under Advanced.
error.invalid_token_format: The auth token must be hexadecimal.
error.client_id_required: Firmware 5.0.0 and later needs the client ID that goes with the token.
error.too_many_pairings: The strip accepts no more controllers. Only a factory reset frees its pairings.

abort.already_in_progress: This strip is already being set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No supported strips heard over Bluetooth. Check the strip is powered and in range of an adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth proxy.
abort.not_supported: This Nanoleaf device is not supported (yet). Supported: Essentials Lightstrip (NL55, NL68), Essentials A19 (NL45) and Secretlab MAGRGB (NL62).

data_description.poll_interval: How often to read the strip. It reports nothing by itself, so changes made in the Nanoleaf app show up within this time. Commands from Home Assistant are immediate either way.

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to the strip at {address}: {error}

auth_failed.message: {name} refused the stored auth token. Pair it again from the repair notification.

update_failed.message: Could not read the strip at {address}: {error}

strip_full.message: {name} is full: it holds {max} scenes, built-in ones included. Remove a scene first.

scenes_unsupported.message: Scenes are not supported on {name} yet: firmware 5.0.0 and later stores them differently.

scene_not_on_strip.message: "{scene}" is not stored on this strip.

scene_already_on_strip.message: "{scene}" is already stored on this strip.

scene_not_in_library.message: "{scene}" is not in the scene library.

scene_exists.message: The library already has a scene called "{scene}".

builtin_protected.message: "{scene}" is a factory scene. It cannot be put back once deleted, so it is never deleted.

no_default_scenes.message: The Nanoleaf app writes no default scenes to {name}.

community_failed.message: The Nanoleaf community library could not be reached: {error}

not_a_strip.message: {entity_id} is not a Nanoleaf Essentials (Bluetooth) light that is loaded.

target_required.message: Choose the strip (its light entity) to do this on.

no_strips_loaded.message: No Nanoleaf Essentials (Bluetooth) strip is loaded.

no_community_scene_selected.message: Search the community first, then choose a scene in Community scene.

no_scene_selected.message: Choose a scene in Scene to manage first.

experimental_firmware.title: {name}: firmware {firmware} support is experimental
experimental_firmware.description:
Firmware 5.0.0 and later speaks a newer protocol that has not been tested on a real strip yet. On/off, brightness, colour and identify should work; scenes and Restore on/off after power loss are not available.

Please report how it goes, with diagnostics attached: {issues_url}

default_scenes_incomplete.title: {name}: not every default scene fits
default_scenes_incomplete.description:
After pairing, the Nanoleaf app writes its default scenes to the strip. The integration did the same, but the strip is full, so these were left out: {scenes}.

Nothing was deleted to make room. Remove a scene you don't need, then press Restore default scenes on the device page.

create_scene.name: Create scene
create_scene.description: Creates a scene in the scene library, shared by all strips. Optionally adds it to strips and plays it.

entity_id.name: Strips
entity_id.description: Strips to add the scene to or play it on (needed for Add to strip and Play).

name.name: Name
name.description: The scene's name, unique in the library.

colours.name: Colours
colours.description: 1 to 7 colours, each [red, green, blue] (0-255), or a mapping with hue (0-360), saturation and brightness (0-100), and optionally repeat (copies of the colour).

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Transition time in tenths of a second (1-255). Default 24.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Hold time in tenths of a second (0-255), for fade, random, highlight and flow. Default 0.

loop.name: Loop
loop.description: Repeat the sequence (fade and flow). Default on.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: Flow and stripes only. Default left.

main_colour_probability.name: Main colour probability
main_colour_probability.description: Highlight only: the chance (%) each new colour is the first one. Default 80.

add_to_strip.name: Add to strip
add_to_strip.description: Store it on the strips, taking a slot.

play.name: Play
play.description: Play it on the strips now.

preview_scene.name: Preview scene
preview_scene.description: Plays a scene without saving it anywhere.

colours.name: Colours
colours.description: 1 to 7 colours, each [red, green, blue] (0-255), or a mapping with hue, saturation, brightness and optionally repeat.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Transition time in tenths of a second (1-255).

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Hold time in tenths of a second (0-255).

add_scene_to_strip.name: Add scene to strip
add_scene_to_strip.description: Stores a library scene on strips, so it plays from the Nanoleaf app too.

remove_scene_from_strip.name: Remove scene from strip
remove_scene_from_strip.description: Deletes a scene from strips. A library copy stays in the library. Factory scenes are never deleted.

scene.name: Scene
scene.description: Name of the scene on the strip.

rename_scene.name: Rename scene
rename_scene.description: Renames a library scene, and its copies on strips.

new_name.name: New name
new_name.description: New name, unique in the library.

delete_library_scene.name: Delete library scene
delete_library_scene.description: Deletes a scene from the library. Copies stored on strips stay there.

search_community_scenes.name: Search community scenes
search_community_scenes.description: Searches the Nanoleaf community scene library and returns the results.

query.name: Query
query.description: Words to search for. Empty lists recent scenes.

sort.name: Sort
sort.description: Most recent or most downloaded first.

preview_community_scene.name: Preview community scene
preview_community_scene.description: Plays a community scene without saving it.

key.name: Key
key.description: The key from a search result.

save_community_scene.name: Save community scene
save_community_scene.description: Saves a community scene to the library, keeping its name, and optionally stores it on strips.

entity_id.name: Strips
entity_id.description: Strips to store it on (needed for Add to strip).

key.name: Key
key.description: The key from a search result.

name.name: Name
name.description: A name of your own instead of the community one.

add_to_strip.name: Add to strip
add_to_strip.description: Also store it on the strips.

restore_default_scenes.name: Restore default scenes
restore_default_scenes.description: Writes back the default scenes the Nanoleaf app gives Secretlab strips, where missing and as space allows. Nothing is deleted.
